name: 3amigos
description: A one-round panel of three independent experts from a pool of four (Codex, Gemini, a Claude Opus agent and a Claude Fable agent; the default panel is Codex, Gemini and Fable) that answer the same brainstorm or triage task as JSON, merged by one non-voting Opus synthesizer by majority and agreement. A voter that fails or misses its deadline is replaced by a Fable stand-in with its own framing.
